name: oh-my-design
description: Give your AI coding agent a design system. One command installs 500+ quality-graded company DESIGN.md references + skills into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode. Free, MIT, zero AI calls.

paragraphs: A design system your coding agent can actually hold. oh-my-design-cli installs the middle that AI UI work keeps missing: a philosophy you declare, tokens and component contracts derived from it, numbered gates for the failures AI repeats, and omd book to read your own system back. 31 skills, 20 specialist roles, 93 preset contracts, 500+ quality-graded references. No API key or MCP server for the core workflows.

oh-my-design (OmD) installs local design workflows into the coding tool you already use. Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode receive reusable skills and specialist roles; Cursor receives native Agent Skills plus a focused project rule that applies the same DESIGN.md. New design-system creation targets the vendor-neutral DESIGN.md Core v2: a concise portable contract that remains useful when pasted into a generic chat or attached to Claude Design/Open Design, with optional structured evidence under .omd/system/. The package also includes 500+ quality-graded company references. Existing reference…
